# Petrol Price Pakistan

> Authoritative, independent consumer portal providing officially verified petroleum prices, historical gazette archives, and vehicle fuel calculators for Pakistan.

## Overview
Petrol Price Pakistan consumes and cross-verifies fuel rates directly from official government circulars released by the Oil & Gas Regulatory Authority (OGRA) and the Federal Ministry of Energy (Petroleum Division). We eliminate rumors and sensationalized rate projections with timestamped mathematical accuracy.

## Regulated Fuel Products
- **Petrol (Motor Spirit / Super 92 RON)**: National regulated ex-depot consumer rate.
- **High-Speed Diesel (HSD)**: Regulated transport, freight, and agricultural rate.
- **Superior Kerosene Oil (SKO)**: Regulated domestic heating and illumination fuel.
- **Light Diesel Oil (LDO)**: Regulated agricultural tubewells and flour mills fuel.
- **LPG (Liquefied Petroleum Gas)**: OGRA monthly maximum consumer rate (per kg and 11.8 kg domestic cylinder).
- **Hi-Octane (97 RON)**: Deregulated commercial premium fuel monitored via Pakistan State Oil (PSO).

## Key URLs & Tools
- [Today's Fuel Rates](https://petrolpricepakistan.pk/): Real-time live prices updated within minutes of official circulars.
- [Petrol Price in Pakistan](https://petrolpricepakistan.pk/petrol-price-in-pakistan): Motor Spirit breakdown, taxation, and revisions.

- [LPG Price in Pakistan](https://petrolpricepakistan.pk/lpg-price-in-pakistan): Liquefied Petroleum Gas monthly cylinder rates.
- [Fuel Price History Archive](https://petrolpricepakistan.pk/petrol-price-history): Historical gazette archive from 2026 backwards.
- [Diesel Price History](https://petrolpricepakistan.pk/diesel-price-history): High-Speed Diesel historical notifications.
- [Price Increases & Decreases](https://petrolpricepakistan.pk/fuel-price-changes): Exact mathematical paisa revisions.
- [Fuel Tank Fill-Up Calculator](https://petrolpricepakistan.pk/petrol-calculator): Accurate fill-up planning tool for bikes, hatchbacks, sedans, and SUVs.
- [Advertise With Us](https://petrolpricepakistan.pk/advertise): Advertising options and media inquiries for Pakistani motorists.

## Pricing Mechanism
Standard petrol and diesel prices in Pakistan are determined on a fortnightly cycle (effective 1st and 16th of each month) under the Petroleum Products (Petroleum Levy) Ordinance and OGRA formula incorporating:
1. Ex-Refinery Price (Arab Gulf Platts benchmark import parity)
2. Inland Freight Equalization Margin (IFEM) pooling national transportation costs
3. Oil Marketing Company (OMC) Margin
4. Dealer Commission
5. Petroleum Development Levy (PDL)
